newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Merchant up sharply on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Merchant up sharply on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka Ltd rose 26.25 percent, or 5.25 rupees, to 25.25 in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
"Since the share is expected to perform well in 1997, investors are buying aggressively and trying to get in before it rises more," said a broker who declined to be identified.

On top of good growth expected in 1997, investor sentiment has also improved following an agreement between the government and the opposition to work together to try to end the country's 13-year ethnic conflict, he said.
